_comment: Per-subject curation for the Slinger unit-analysis video. The METHOD lives in code; this file holds only Slinger-specific choices.
_ingame_note: STOPGAP PINS, 2026-07-27 — every one is a recorded tape from the golden rig, not a guess. The engine still overrates the Slinger against heavy melee even after the CATCH fix (see sim_v2_model.js): it had the Slinger BEATING both elephants and most knights. Tapes: 21 Slinger vs 4 War Elephant -> 0 Slingers, 4 elephants at 1844hp; vs 6 Battle Elephant -> 0 Slingers, 6 at 1354hp; vs 7 Paladin -> 0 Slingers, 7 at 798hp (x2 runs); vs 15 Hussar -> 0 Slingers, 13 at 833hp. Confirming the other direction: vs 9 Temple Guard -> 18 Slingers left; vs 9 Teutonic Knight -> 18 left; vs 15 Champion -> 18 left. The ~10 remaining knight rows the sim still calls Slinger wins are UNVERIFIED and probably wrong the same way — they are deliberately kept OFF camera. Retire these pins once the engine earns the result natively. || RANGED-vs-RANGED tapes (2026-07-27, newly filmable after the both-ranged template rule): 21 Slinger BEATS 13 Elite Chu Ko Nu (9 Slingers left, all CKN dead) and BEATS 5 Elite Hussite Wagon (9 left) — the sim called both expected losses. It LOSES to 21 Elite Skirmishers 0 v 17, which the sim got right: the Elite Skirmisher's 8 pierce armour drops the Slinger's 9 attack to minimum damage, while the Chu Ko Nu's ~1 armour does not. So the Slinger's real profile is anti-infantry AND anti-archer, walled off by pierce armour, cavalry and elephants.
_showcase_note: Eight filmed fights, every one verified against its category. The both-ranged template rule (build_golden_v2) made archer/gunpowder opponents filmable for the first time, which is where the two unexpected wins come from. Still OFF camera on purpose: the ~10 knight rows the sim calls Slinger wins are unverified and, given the Paladin tape, probably wrong the same way the elephants were.
